purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) over January-June 2013, sourced from ASOS station data via the nycflights13 weather dataset, to support analyses joining flight delays to weather conditions at origin airports.
usage: Join on origin_code and observed_at_utc to align with the flights table's origin and scheduled time columns. Consumers must treat nulls in wind_gust_mph (74.6% missing), sea_level_pressure_millibars (11.5% missing), and the smaller gaps in wind_direction_degrees and wind_speed_mph as genuine missing observations rather than zero readings.
limitations: The original year, month, day, and hour integer parts were dropped as fully redundant with the consolidated observed_at_utc timestamp; consumers needing those parts separately must derive them from observed_at_utc. wind_gust_mph is missing in 74.6% of rows and sea_level_pressure_millibars in 11.5% of rows; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication logic was applied.
